options.name: dns_iface
options.description: DNS Interface,input like 'eth0', 'eth1', 'bond0'. Required when I(dns_manual=auto).

options.name: dns_manual
options.description: DNS Settings.

options.name: dns_priority
options.description: IP Priority. Required when I(dns_manual=auto).

options.name: dns_server1
options.description: DNS Server1 IPv4 or IPv6 address. Required when I(dns_manual=manual).

options.name: dns_server2
options.description: DNS Server2 IPv4 or IPv6 address. Required when I(dns_manual=manual).

options.name: dns_server3
options.description: DNS Server3 IPv4 or IPv6 address. Required when I(dns_manual=manual).

options.name: dns_status
options.description: DNS status.

options.name: domain_iface
options.description: Network Interface,input like 'eth0_v4', 'eth0_v6', 'eth1_v4', 'eth1_v6', 'bond0_v4', 'bond0_v6'. Required when I(domain_manual=auto).

options.name: domain_manual
options.description: Domain Settings.

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Domain Name. Required when I(domain_manual=manual).

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: host_cfg
options.description: Host Settings.

options.name: host_name
options.description: Host Name. Required when I(host_cfg=manual).

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: register_status1
options.description: BMC register status 1. Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: register_status2
options.description: BMC register status 2. Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: registration_method1
options.description: Registration method 1. Only the M6 model supports this parameter. Required when I(register_status1=enable).

options.name: registration_method2
options.description: Registration method 2. Only the M6 model supports this parameter. Required when I(register_status2=enable).

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
